summary: Cheniere Energy Partners, L.P. filed an 8-K solely to declare a quarterly cash distribution of $0.790 per common unit ($0.775 base plus $0.015 variable), payable May 15, 2026 to holders of record May 8, 2026. The filing includes a press release and notice regarding US withholding tax for foreign unitholders. There is no special-situation transaction or event (no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring, etc.). This is a routine, periodic distribution announcement.
